CLIPORA / PROJECT

Made for the things you copy every day.

Clipora is an independently developed Windows clipboard manager. Its job is straightforward: help you find and reuse the useful things you have already copied.

On this page

A smaller interruption in your day

A reply, a link, an image or a fragment of an idea can be useful more than once. Clipora brings those items into a searchable library and opens a compact picker near your destination field.

The app is built with C#/.NET, WinUI 3 and SQLite. It is distributed as Clipora Clipboard on Microsoft Store, with publisher display name Clipora. This is its official product website at clipora.deltabits.in.

The product’s working principles

  • Local by default. History stays on the PC unless you deliberately configure optional sync or export it.
  • Recording you can stop. A visible Pause control and app exclusions help you decide what belongs in history.
  • Useful before impressive. Search, pins, image previews and a reliable way to back up matter more than a long feature checklist.
  • Clear limits. A clipboard manager cannot recover copies it never recorded, and Windows can restrict automatic input.

See the privacy notice for encryption, storage and deletion details.

Feedback and support

The public support tracker is the current route for bug reports and feature requests. It requires a GitHub account. Include your app version, Windows version and steps using synthetic examples.

Do not attach clipboard history, passwords, encryption keys, private file paths or customer information. Reports are public. Clipora does not provide email support at this time.

Troubleshoot a problem, read release notes or get the press kit.
